title: Sonic Advance
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 793 (addresses converted to GBA bus addresses)
gbaverify + own RAM search: rings 0->3->5->12 while running Neo Green Hill 1 (0x03002738), lives 3->2 on a time over, act timer in frames 0x03004FE4

rows: top speed; Spin Dash (hold Down + B); spin attack in the air
flies (B in the air), slower top speed; can carry no partner here
glides (hold B in the air) and climbs walls; best for hidden paths
hammer attacks, no spin; unlocked after the story is cleared with the other three

widgets.text: 100 rings = 1 extra life; hit with 0 rings = lose a life

rows: A or B; Spin Dash: hold Down, tap A/B, release
press Down while running to curl and break enemies

widgets.text:
Springs and dash panels carry you; keep momentum on loops
Ring shield, bubble, invincibility and speed shoes come from item boxes

rows: separate mini-mode from the title menu

widgets.text:
Every zone ends with Eggman in a machine in Act 2
Hit the cockpit 8 times; jump on top or hit from below
Keep at least one ring: any ring saves you from a hit

rows: X Zone (all 7 Chaos Emeralds with Sonic) = true final boss

1 Neo Green Hill - 2 Secret Base - 3 Casino Paradise
4 Ice Mountain - 5 Angel Island - 6 Egg Rocket
7 Cosmic Angel - X Zone (true ending)

rows: absorbs one hit; Magnetic shield: pulls rings
a few seconds of no damage
faster running for a few seconds

widgets.text:
7 Chaos Emeralds from Special Stages

rows: gather the ring target in the halfpipe before time runs out

widgets.text: Emeralds are per save file and per character

Clear all 7 zones to see the ending
